meaning: Starting grid after penalties. Known before the race. 0 means no grid slot, and it is not filled in.
1 when the grid is 1 or 2, otherwise 0. Missing when the grid itself is missing.
Official qualifying position for this race. Known after qualifying. Missing when that session is not in the file.
1 when the driver set a Q3 time. Missing for a whole race that did not use Q3, so a blank is not treated as an elimination.
1 when quali_position is missing, so an imputed position is not mistaken for a real one.
Share of this driver's previous 5 starts that were podiums. This race is excluded.
Points from this driver's previous 5 starts. This race's points are excluded.
Mean podium share of this constructor's cars over its previous 5 races. This race is excluded.
Number of race starts this driver had before this one.
1 on a driver's first start in the file, when the previous-5 rates do not exist.
Driver championship position after the previous round. The standings row for this race is not used.
Constructor championship position after the previous round.
1 when there is no driver standings row for the previous round. That includes every round 1.
Round number in the season. It is known when the calendar is published.
1 when the circuit's country matches the driver's nationality. A dual national matches either country.
